race.comment: CAPTAIN HAPPY (4) produced a real eye-catcher first-up over 1050m then wasn't the best away so did a reasonable job to be beaten just two lengths last start over this course and distance. Everything points towards a peak performance this afternoon. BLANKFIELD (2) improved last time out at the second run of the campaign, closing strongly to be beaten just over a length over 1200m at Pakenham. Wasn't all that far away at stakes level last time in work. Has the right credentials to play a significant role. MAYSOONFLY (7) was rewarded for consistency with a dogged win over 1200m at Gawler recently. In tremendous form so although up a little in class she is a definite contender dropping down to 55.5kgs. Last start Gawler winner MUSICAL SUNSET (8) has a tougher assignment ahead of her today but she is lightly raced with plenty of scope for improvement. TOOK GARDNER (6) returns from a 9-week spell. Showed plenty of ability in the maiden prep and can bob up while fresh.
